bridge_mcp.purpose: Read-only terminal inspection through SSH tunnels. It does not ingest telemetry into StratOS.
bridge_mcp.operator_action: Renew the bearer token only in the existing private MCP configuration; never version or paste it here.

direct_connector.purpose: Continuous sealed read-only ingestion of positions, deals, equity, and heartbeat into the operational core.
direct_connector.core_engine_url_requirement: HTTPS URL reachable from each VPS; localhost is not valid.
